text: The modular SIMATIC S7-1500 controller offers scalable functionality, letting you adapt assemblies and functions to your machine design. Its modules are IP20-approved and designed for control cabinet installation.
heading: Scalable and adaptable

text: Achieve top performance and productivity with SIMATIC S7-1500 – featuring a fast backplane bus, PROFINET with deterministic µs -precision, shortest reaction times, and CPU command processing in as little as ⅓ ns.
heading: Precise and fast

text: Reliability is key to your productivity and cost-effectiveness. With reliable components you avoid downtime. In addition you benefit from customized solutions for harsh environments, extreme temperatures and special conditions.
heading: Reliable and customizable

text: Modular SIMATIC S7-1500 offers scalable functionality with multiple CPU performance classes, I/O, technology and communication modules for centralized or distributed setups. IP20-rated for control cabinet installation.
heading: Modular Controller

text: Distributed Controllers combine SIMATIC S7-1500 performance with ET 200 design. Distributed intelligence improves availability, supports compact machine installations, and connects to central control cabinets via PROFINET.
heading: Distributed Controller

text: SIMATIC S7-1500 Software Controllers combine PLC reliability with PC flexibility. Available in standard and fail-safe versions, they are OS-independent, support C++ integration, scale as needed, and ensure high availability.
heading: Software Controller

text: SIMATIC S7-1500 T-CPUs automate Advanced Motion Control applications with dynamic and precise synchronized multi-axis systems and kinematics. Available in modular, distributed, drive-integrated or PC-based designs.
heading: Technology Controller

text: Redundant SIMATIC S7-1500 R/H CPUs maximize availability with synchronized backup controllers. Integrated redundancy prevents data loss and downtime while simplifying engineering and maintenance, even in distributed plants.
heading: Redundant Controller

text: SIMATIC S7-300 and S7-400 controllers are proven PLCs for factory and process automation. Used worldwide in millions of applications, they provide continuity, reliability, and long-term investment protection.
heading: Legacy Controller

text: Bring SIMATIC S7-1500 power to Industrial Edge

SIMATIC S7-1500V is a fully virtual PLC based on the familiar functionality and operation of the SIMATIC S7-1500, while being completely hardware-independent. Available as an Edge app, it integrates directly into IT environments and supports digitalization initiatives. The virtual controller enables more flexible, modular production plant designs and helps create highly adaptable manufacturing processes.
